title: Reassigning ownership and rotating the server secret
decision: An administrator may make any person known to the service the owner of a shop, with a reason and a fresh code; the former owner becomes a suspended manager, because a lost account may be in someone else's hands; the old account is told only that ownership was changed by the administration; a pending deletion is left as it is and the new owner is told its date; the five-shop limit applies; a previous server secret is accepted during a rotation and file links signed with it live out their five minutes
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 64
rationale: BR-22 says what a former owner becomes after a transfer; nothing says what happens when the owner is gone
